# SRV Detailing

> SRV Detailing is a professional mobile car valeting and detailing company based in Dukinfield, Greater Manchester. We travel directly to customers — at home, at work, or any suitable location — across Manchester, Stockport, Warrington, Macclesfield, Congleton, Wilmslow, and the wider Cheshire area. Over 22 years of industry experience. Phone: 07375 759686.

## Frequently Asked Questions

- **Does SRV Detailing come to my home?** Yes. SRV Detailing is fully mobile. We bring all equipment and products to your driveway, workplace car park, or any other suitable location.
- **What areas does SRV Detailing cover?** We cover all of Greater Manchester, Stockport, Tameside, Warrington, Macclesfield, Congleton, Wilmslow, Alderley Edge, Knutsford, and the wider Cheshire area.
- **How much does a full car valet cost?** A full valet with SRV Detailing starts from £65 for most vehicles. Larger vehicles (SUVs, vans) may be slightly higher.
- **How much does ceramic coating cost?** Ceramic coating packages start from £300 for entry-level 3-year protection, up to £1,200+ for premium 7-year coatings.
- **How long does a full detail take?** A full detail including paint correction and ceramic coating typically takes 1–2 days. A full valet takes 2–3 hours.
- **Do I need to be present during the service?** No. As long as we can safely access your vehicle, you do not need to be present.
- **How often should I have my car valeted?** We recommend a full valet every 2–3 months and a professional detail every 6–12 months.
- **What products does SRV Detailing use?** We use professional-grade products from trusted brands including Gtechniq, Koch-Chemie, and Meguiar's.
- **Is SRV Detailing available on weekends?** Yes — we are available 7 days a week including weekends and bank holidays.
- **How do I book SRV Detailing?** Call 07375 759686 or use the contact form at https://www.srvdetailing.co.uk/contact
